# Execution quality — session of @day (Wed 11 Nov 2026)

Markout = signed (venue mid at fill + horizon − fill px), in bps of fill px and in USD (GBP 1.3287, EUR 1.107; NBP pence → GBP). Fills are measured against **their own venue's** quote. Variables: `day`, `event` (gas-rally window, excluded where noted), `mark_window`. Change `day` to rerun for another session; `event` and `mark_window` are specific to 11 Nov.

**What it shows:** 1) In aggregate we are *not* picked off: passive fills earn about +$97k at fill, rising to +$137k at 1m. 2) The exception is **NBP on ICE**: passive fills capture ~0 bps at fill (half-spread is ~0.5 bps), and on NBP strips they come in −1.8 bps *through* the mid. 3) 23 passive fills printed through the touch (NBP/UKPWR/TTF on ICE), costing ~−$17k. 4) The big NBP losses at 5m come from the **09:30–09:55 gas rally** (NBP +8%, TTF +7.5%). That is market direction, not fill quality. 5) **Not execution:** trader_11 manually marked TTF_Q1-27 about €2.5 above market from 08:00 to 08:29. 6) GASOIL is 100% aggressive (−$66k of spread paid).

WITH m AS (
  SELECT t.ts, t.passive, h.offset AS off,
         t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END) AS usd
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 5s, 1m, 5m) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day
)
SELECT CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity,
       CASE WHEN ts IN @event THEN 'gas rally window' ELSE 'rest of day' END AS window_,
       count() / 4 AS fills,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN off = 0 THEN usd END)) AS usd_at_fill,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN off = 5000000000 THEN usd END)) AS usd_5s,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN off = 60000000000 THEN usd END)) AS usd_1m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN off = 300000000000 THEN usd END)) AS usd_5m
FROM m ORDER BY liquidity, window_ DESC
cells.name: Day totals · markout USD by liquidity and window

cells.value:
SELECT h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_s, t.curve,
       avg(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS markout_bps
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 1s, 5s, 15s, 30s, 1m, 2m, 5m) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive AND NOT (t.ts IN @event)
ORDER BY horizon_s, t.curve
cells.name: Passive markout curve by commodity (bps, excl. rally window)

SELECT ts, close AS NBP_Dec26_mid FROM energy_quotes_1m WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol = 'NBP_Dec-26';
SELECT ts, close AS TTF_Dec26_mid FROM energy_quotes_1m WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol = 'TTF_Dec-26'
cells.name: Gas rally: NBP Dec-26 (p/th, left) vs TTF Dec-26 (€/MWh, right), 1m mid

cells.value:
SELECT t.curve, t.venue, CASE WHEN t.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity,
       count() / 5 AS fills,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN (q.ask - q.bid) / t.px * 10000 / 2 END), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_at_fill,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 5000000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_5s,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 30000000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_30s,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_1m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END) END)) AS usd_at_fill,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 60000000000 THEN t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END) END)) AS usd_1m
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 5s, 30s, 1m, 5m) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND NOT (t.ts IN @event)
ORDER BY liquidity DESC, bps_1m
cells.name: Scorecard · commodity × venue × liquidity (excl. rally window)

cells.value:
SELECT t.trader, t.book, t.curve, count() / 3 AS fills,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_at_fill,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 30000000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_30s,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END) END)) AS usd_at_fill,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN h.offset = 30000000000 THEN t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END) END)) AS usd_30s
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 30s, 1m) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive AND NOT (t.ts IN @event)
ORDER BY usd_30s
LIMIT 15
cells.name: Who · passive fills by trader and commodity (excl. rally window)

cells.value:
SELECT t.ts, t.trader, t.symbol, t.venue, t.qty, t.px, q.bid, q.ask,
       round(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000, 2) AS bps_vs_mid,
       round(t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END)) AS usd_vs_mid
FROM energy_fills t
ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive
  AND ((t.qty > 0 AND t.px > q.ask) OR (t.qty < 0 AND t.px < q.bid))
ORDER BY usd_vs_mid
cells.name: Pick-off log · passive fills printed through the touch

cells.value:
SELECT t.curve,
       CASE WHEN t.symbol ~ '_(Q[1-4]|Sum|Win|Cal)-' THEN 'strip' ELSE 'month' END AS tenor,
       CASE WHEN t.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity,
       count() / 2 AS fills,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN (q.ask - q.bid) / t.px * 10000 / 2 END), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 0 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_at_fill,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN h.offset = 30000000000 THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END), 2) AS bps_30s
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 30s) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND NOT (t.ts IN @event) AND t.curve IN ('NBP', 'TTF', 'UKPWR')
ORDER BY t.curve, tenor, liquidity
cells.name: Strips vs months · passive capture vs half-spread (excl. rally window)

cells.value:
SELECT t.ts, t.trader, t.book, t.symbol, t.passive, t.qty, t.px,
       round(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000, 1) AS bps_5m,
       round(t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END)) AS usd_5m
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (5m) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @event AND t.curve IN ('NBP', 'TTF', 'UKPWR')
ORDER BY t.ts
cells.name: Rally window · NBP/TTF/UKPWR fills and 5m markout

SELECT ts, price AS curve_mark FROM energy_curve_marks WHERE ts IN @mark_window AND symbol = 'TTF_Q1-27' AND version = 1;
SELECT ts, close AS market_mid FROM energy_quotes_1m WHERE ts IN @mark_window AND symbol = 'TTF_Q1-27'
cells.name: Not execution: TTF_Q1-27 curve mark vs market mid (manual override 08:00–08:29)

cells.value:
SELECT k.symbol, k.source, k.marked_by, min(k.ts) AS first_mark, max(k.ts) AS last_mark, count() AS minutes,
       round(avg(k.price - m.close), 3) AS avg_mark_minus_mid
FROM energy_curve_marks k
ASOF JOIN energy_quotes_1m m ON (symbol)
WHERE k.ts IN @day AND k.version = 1 AND k.source NOT IN ('MARKET', 'INTERP')
GROUP BY k.symbol, k.source, k.marked_by
cells.name: Manual / non-market marks on the day

cells.value:
SELECT t.curve, count() AS fills,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN t.passive THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(), 1) AS passive_pct,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT t.passive THEN t.qty * ((q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px) * (CASE t.curve WHEN 'NBP' THEN 0.013287 WHEN 'UKPWR' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'UKA' THEN 1.3287 WHEN 'TTF' THEN 1.107 WHEN 'EUA' THEN 1.107 ELSE 1.0 END) END)) AS aggressive_usd_at_fill
FROM energy_fills t
ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
WHERE t.ts IN @day
ORDER BY aggressive_usd_at_fill
cells.name: Liquidity mix · passive share and spread paid by commodity
